algorithm: AES-256-CBC on decoded RGB bytes, PKCS7 padding

metric_definition.npcr_uaci: Compare two ciphertext RGB visualizations with identical key and IV, after flipping one bit in the first plaintext pixel. NPCR is fraction of changed RGB pixels; UACI averages absolute differences across RGB channels divided by 255.
metric_definition.entropy: Shannon entropy across all decoded RGB channel byte values.
metric_definition.correlation: Pearson correlation of up to 10,000 evenly sampled horizontal neighbor red-channel pairs; null means zero variance.
metric_definition.mse_psnr: Compare original RGB against encrypted pixel visualization and against recovered RGB. Perfect recovery has MSE 0 and PSNR Infinity, stored as a string in JSON.
metric_definition.visualization: First width*height*3 ciphertext bytes mapped to RGB. This is not a valid encrypted JPEG file format.
